title: The School Ghost
lines: Kids at school said a ghost lived there.
At night it made a long, sad sound.
The chef said it was just the wind.
But Meg went to look one dark night.
She saw a sign on a back door.
In the dark she saw green eyes shine.
It was a cat! No ghost at all.

questions.ask: What did the kids think was in the school?
questions.listenFor: A ghost. It is in the very first line.

questions.ask: What was really making the sound?
questions.listenFor: A cat. Meg found it behind the door with the STOP sign.

questions.ask: Was it a good idea for Meg to go in? Why?
questions.listenFor: Either answer works. Listen for the thinking, not the verdict.
